equation magnetization lifetimeτ = τ0 exp[KV/kT]. interface carrier hypothesisAggregation may introduce fusion-interface defects providing carriers for double exchange, RKKY or Zener coupling, while larger domains raise anisotropy barriers. These mechanisms are proposed, with experiments still in progress.author derivedSource-reported observationaggregateschwartz2003 · Main PDF p. 13, printed p. 13217, IV.D.v
author intrinsic ferromagnetism claimThe authors attribute room-temperature ferromagnetism to substitutional dopants rather than segregated phases, using unchanged diffraction and low-temperature aggregation. This is their interpretation of the reported evidence, not an independent modern verification.author derivedSource-reported observationaggregateschwartz2003 · Main PDF p. 13, printed p. 13217, IV.D.v; schwartz2003 · Main PDF p. 14, printed p. 13218, Conclusion
